title: House of the Rising Sun
description: A 2:49 seven-mouth folk choir arrangement of the traditional tune, with new verse words, answering harmonies, a wordless bridge and a layered final refrain.

melody.name: Lead
melody.lyrics: The tide rolls on beneath the moon The streets grow dark and still I hear a song beyond the doors And feel the night grow chill There is a house in New Or-leans They call the Rising Sun The lights still burn but hope is gone Beneath the rising sun At dawn the road will call my name I'll take the path back home And leave the lamps beside the rain Where shadows used to roam There is a house in New Or-leans They call the Rising Sun The lights still burn but hope is gone Beneath the rising sun
melody.source: Traditional folk melody and opening lines · new verse words and vocal arrangement
